rules.unknown_client: Only the clients listed for a server may send it Modbus requests.
rules.forbidden_function: A client may only use the function codes listed for that server.
rules.illegal_address: A request may only touch registers inside the server's register map (get_register_map).
rules.unauthorized_write: Only clients marked as writer may use a write function code (5, 6, 15, 16, 23).
